Metadata.title: ShootFlow
Metadata.description: Shoot planning, shot list, proofing and delivery in one place.

Home.title: Every shoot, from moodboard to final gallery
Home.lead: Agree on looks with your model through one link, run the shot list on set, and deliver the finals without the back-and-forth.

Auth.signInLead: Sign in to open your projects.
Auth.signUpLead: A photographer account. Models and clients open their link without signing up.
Auth.name: Your name or studio name
Auth.nameHint: This is what your clients will see. You can change it later.
Auth.magicLinkHint: We'll email you a sign-in link. If you don't have an account yet, one will be created.
Auth.checkEmail: We sent an email to {email}. Open the link in it on this device.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email with the link we sent first.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or use an email link.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too simple: use at least 8 characters.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Auth.otherBrowser: The link opened in a different browser from the one you used. If you were signing up, your email is already confirmed — just sign in here.

Dashboard.title: Projects
Dashboard.emptyLead: Create a project for each shoot: date, place, client and everything to agree on.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.appearanceLead: Theme and interface language. The language is saved to your profile and follows you across devices.
Settings.calendarLead: All your studio's shoots in your calendar app. It updates by itself when you change a project.
Settings.calendarHint: Apple Calendar and Outlook: press Subscribe. Google Calendar: Other calendars → From URL, then paste the link. Keep the link private: anyone with it sees your shoots.
Settings.calendarRotateConfirm: Calendars subscribed with the old link will stop updating.
Settings.storageLead: Photos and files of all your projects.
Settings.comingSoon: Profile, studio, watermark and Telegram settings arrive in the next steps.

Portal.title: Your shoot
Portal.lead: Your photographer shares everything you need for the shoot here.
Portal.shootLead: When and where we shoot, with an “Add to calendar” button.
Portal.conceptLead: Moodboard and wardrobe: approve them or ask for a change.
Portal.galleryLead: Pick your favourites for retouching, then get the final gallery.
Portal.comingSoon: The portal is in development: details of your shoot will appear here soon.

Project.clientLinkLead: Send this to your client: it opens their shoot page without signing up. The client page is still in development.

Uploader.drop: Drop photos or PDF files here, or click to choose
Uploader.hint: Images and PDF, up to 100 MB each.

Files.title: Files
Files.lead: References, briefs and anything else for this shoot. Only you can see them.
Files.disabled: File uploads need Cloudflare R2 and the Supabase secret key on the server.
